Additionally, the cap textures (white warts) show slight uniformity and edge bleeding (severity ~1.5). While the overall structure is sound and the mask is coherent, these subtle boundary and texture inconsistencies prevent a higher artifact score. It is better than the 'mid' reference (hammerhead with visible distortion) but worse than the 'high' reference (clean bird photo).
